question: How many United Airlines flights go to City 'Aberdeen'?

sql.W1: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM airlines WHERE Airline = 'United Airlines' AND Country = 'USA' AND City = 'Aberdeen'
sql.W2:
SELECT COUNT(T2.FlightNo) AS FlightCount
FROM airlines AS T1
JOIN flights AS T2 ON T1.uid = T2.Airline
JOIN airports AS T3 ON T2.DestAirport = T3.AirportCode
WHERE T1.Airline = 'United Airlines' AND T3.City = 'Aberdeen'
sql.W3:
SELECT COUNT(T2.FlightNo) AS FlightCount
FROM airlines AS T1
JOIN flights AS T2 ON T1.uid = T2.Airline
JOIN airports AS T3 ON T2.DestAirport = T3.AirportCode
WHERE T1.Airline = 'United Airlines' AND T3.City = 'Aberdeen'
sql.W4:
SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM flights 
JOIN airlines ON flights.Airline = airlines.uid 
JOIN airports AS source ON flights.SourceAirport = source.AirportCode 
JOIN airports AS dest ON flights.DestAirport = dest.AirportCode 
WHERE airlines.Airline = 'United' AND dest.City = 'Aberdeen'
sql.E: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM airlines WHERE Airline = 'United Airlines' AND Country = 'USA' AND City = 'Aberdeen'

question: What is the id and type code for the template used by the most documents?

sql.W1: SELECT Template_ID, 'type_code' AS Type_Code FROM Documents GROUP BY Template_ID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
sql.W2:
SELECT T.Template_ID, T.Template_Type_Code 
FROM Templates T
JOIN (
    SELECT Template_ID, COUNT(*) as DocCount
    FROM Documents
    GROUP BY Template_ID
    ORDER BY DocCount DESC
    LIMIT 1
) D ON T.Template_ID = D.Template_ID
JOIN Ref_Template_Types RT ON T.Template_Type_Code = RT.Template_Type_Code
sql.W3:
SELECT T.Template_ID, T.Template_Type_Code 
FROM Templates T
JOIN (
    SELECT Template_ID, COUNT(*) as DocCount
    FROM Documents
    GROUP BY Template_ID
    ORDER BY DocCount DESC
    LIMIT 1
) D ON T.Template_ID = D.Template_ID
JOIN Ref_Template_Types RT ON T.Template_Type_Code = RT.Template_Type_Code
sql.W4:
SELECT T.Template_ID, RTT.Template_Type_Code 
FROM Templates T
JOIN Documents D ON T.Template_ID = D.Template_ID
GROUP BY T.Template_ID, RTT.Template_Type_Code
ORDER BY COUNT(D.Document_ID) DESC
LIMIT 1
sql.E: SELECT Template_ID, 'type_code' AS Type_Code FROM Documents GROUP BY Template_ID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What are the id, name and membership level of visitors who have spent the largest amount of money in total in all museum tickets?

sql.W1:
SELECT v.id, v.name, v.membership_level
FROM visitor v
JOIN (
    SELECT visitor_ID, SUM(Total_spent) AS total_spent
    FROM visit
    GROUP BY visitor_ID
    ORDER BY total_spent DESC
    LIMIT 1
) t ON v.ID = t.visitor_ID
sql.W2:
SELECT v.ID, v.Name, v.Level_of_membership FROM visitor v JOIN (
    SELECT visitor_ID, SUM(Total_spent) AS total_spent
    FROM visit
    GROUP BY visitor_ID
    ORDER BY total_spent DESC
    LIMIT 1
) t ON v.ID = t.visitor_ID
sql.W3:
SELECT v.ID, v.Name, v.Level_of_membership FROM visitor v JOIN (
    SELECT visitor_ID, SUM(Total_spent) AS total_spent
    FROM visit
    GROUP BY visitor_ID
    ORDER BY total_spent DESC
    LIMIT 1
) t ON v.ID = t.visitor_ID
sql.W4: SELECT v.ID, v.Name, v.Level_of_membership FROM visitor v JOIN visit vt ON v.ID = vt.visitor_ID WHERE vt.Total_spent = (SELECT MAX(Total_spent) FROM visit) GROUP BY v.ID, v.Name, v.Level_of_membership
sql.E:
SELECT v.id, v.name, v.membership_level
FROM visitor v
JOIN (
    SELECT visitor_ID, SUM(Total_spent) AS total_spent
    FROM visit
    GROUP BY visitor_ID
    ORDER BY total_spent DESC
    LIMIT 1

question: find id of the tv channels that from the countries where have more than two tv channels.

sql.W1: SELECT id FROM TV_Channel GROUP BY Country HAVING COUNT(id) > 1
sql.W2: SELECT id FROM TV_Channel GROUP BY Country HAVING COUNT(id) > 2
sql.W3:
SELECT T1.id 
FROM TV_Channel AS T1
JOIN (
    SELECT Country, COUNT(*) AS channel_count
    FROM TV_Channel
    GROUP BY Country
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 2
) AS T2
ON T1.Country = T2.Country
GROUP BY T1.id
sql.W4:
SELECT T2.id 
FROM TV_Channel AS T1
JOIN TV_Channel AS T2 ON T1.Country = T2.Country
GROUP BY T2.id, T2.Country
HAVING COUNT(T2.id) > 2
sql.E: SELECT id FROM TV_Channel GROUP BY Country HAVING COUNT(id) > 1

sql.W2: SELECT T1.Language FROM countrylanguage AS T1 JOIN country AS T2 ON T1.CountryCode = T2.Code WHERE T2.GovernmentForm = 'Republic' AND T1.IsOfficial IS NULL GROUP BY T1.Language HAVING COUNT(T1.CountryCode) = 1
sql.W3:
SELECT T1.Language 
FROM countrylanguage AS T1
JOIN country AS T2 ON T1.CountryCode = T2.Code
WHERE T2.GovernmentForm = 'Republic'
GROUP BY T1.Language
HAVING COUNT(T1.CountryCode) = 1
sql.W4: SELECT T2.Language FROM country AS T1 JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code = T2.CountryCode WHERE T1.GovernmentForm = 'Republic' AND T2.IsOfficial = 'TRUE' GROUP BY T2.Language HAVING COUNT(T2.Language) = 1
sql.E: SELECT Language FROM countrylanguage WHERE IsOfficial = 'N' AND Percentage = 100 GROUP BY Language HAVING COUNT(CountryCode) = 1 AND (SELECT GovernmentType FROM country WHERE Code = CountryCode) = 'Republic'

question: Find the average life expectancy and total population for each continent where the average life expectancy is shorter than 72?

sql.W1: SELECT Continent, AVG(LifeExpectancy), SUM(Population) FROM country WHERE AVG(LifeExpectancy) < 72 GROUP BY Continent
sql.W2:
SELECT c.Continent, AVG(t.LifeExpectancy) AS AverageLifeExpectancy, SUM(t.Population) AS TotalPopulation
FROM country c
JOIN city t ON c.Code = t.CountryCode
WHERE AVG(t.LifeExpectancy) < 72
GROUP BY c.Continent
sql.W3:
SELECT c.Continent, AVG(t.LifeExpectancy) AS AvgLifeExpectancy, SUM(t.Population) AS TotalPopulation
FROM country c
JOIN city t ON c.Code = t.CountryCode
JOIN countrylanguage l ON c.Code = l.CountryCode
GROUP BY c.Continent
HAVING AVG(t.LifeExpectancy) < 72
sql.W4:
SELECT T2.Continent, AVG(T1.LifeExpectancy) AS AvgLifeExpectancy, SUM(T1.Population) AS TotalPopulation
FROM country AS T1
JOIN countrylanguage AS T3 ON T1.Code = T3.CountryCode
JOIN city AS T4 ON T1.Capital = T4.ID
JOIN country AS T2 ON T1.Code = T2.Code
GROUP BY T2.Continent
HAVING AVG(T1.LifeExpectancy) <
sql.E: SELECT Continent, AVG(LifeExpectancy), SUM(Population) FROM country WHERE AVG(LifeExpectancy) < 72 GROUP BY Continent

question: What are the different continents and the total popuation and average life expectancy corresponding to each, for continents that have an average life expectancy less than 72?

sql.W1:
SELECT T1.Continent, SUM(T1.Population) AS TotalPopulation, AVG(T1.LifeExpectancy) AS AverageLifeExpectancy
FROM country AS T1
JOIN (
    SELECT Continent
    FROM country
    GROUP BY Continent
    HAVING AVG(LifeExpectancy) < 72
) AS T2 ON T1.Continent = T2.Continent
GROUP BY T1.Continent
sql.W2:
SELECT c.Continent, SUM(city.Population) AS Total_Population, AVG(country.LifeExpectancy) AS Average_Life_Expectancy
FROM country
JOIN city ON country.Code = city.CountryCode
JOIN countrylanguage ON country.Code = countrylanguage.CountryCode
GROUP BY c.Continent
HAVING AVG(country.LifeExpectancy) < 72
sql.W3:
SELECT c.Continent, SUM(c.Population), AVG(cl.LifeExpectancy) 
FROM country c 
JOIN city ci ON c.Code = ci.CountryCode 
JOIN countrylanguage cl ON c.Code = cl.CountryCode 
GROUP BY c.Continent 
HAVING AVG(cl.LifeExpectancy) < 72
sql.W4:
SELECT c.Continent, SUM(city.Population) AS TotalPopulation, AVG(city.LifeExpectancy) AS AverageLifeExpectancy
FROM country c
JOIN city ON c.Code = city.CountryCode
JOIN countrylanguage cl ON c.Code = cl.CountryCode
GROUP BY c.Continent
HAVING AVG(city.LifeExpectancy) < 72
sql.E:
SELECT T1.Continent, SUM(T1.Population) AS TotalPopulation, AVG(T1.LifeExpectancy) AS AverageLifeExpectancy
FROM country AS T1
JOIN (
    SELECT Continent
    FROM country
    GROUP BY Continent
    HAVING AVG(LifeExpectancy) < 72
) AS T2 ON T1.Continent = T2.Continent
GROUP BY T1.Continent

question: What is the language spoken by the largest percentage of people in each country?

sql.W1: SELECT CountryCode, Language FROM countrylanguage WHERE Percentage = (SELECT MAX(Percentage) FROM countrylanguage) GROUP BY CountryCode, Language
sql.W2: SELECT T1.Language, T1.CountryCode FROM countrylanguage AS T1 JOIN country AS T2 ON T1.CountryCode = T2.Code WHERE T1.Percentage = (SELECT MAX(Percentage) FROM countrylanguage WHERE CountryCode = T1.CountryCode) GROUP BY T1.CountryCode
sql.W3:
SELECT c.Name AS Country, cl.Language 
FROM country c 
JOIN countrylanguage cl ON c.Code = cl.CountryCode 
WHERE (cl.Percentage / 100) * (SELECT MAX(PERCENTAGE / 100) FROM countrylanguage WHERE CountryCode = c.Code) = cl.Percentage 
GROUP BY c.Name, cl.Language
sql.W4:
SELECT T2.Language, MAX(T2.Percentage) AS MaxPercentage 
FROM country AS T1 
JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code = T2.CountryCode 
GROUP BY T2.Language
sql.E: SELECT CountryCode, Language FROM countrylanguage WHERE Percentage = (SELECT MAX(Percentage) FROM countrylanguage) GROUP BY CountryCode, Language

SELECT T1.date_of_treatment AS arriving_date, T1.date_of_treatment AS departing_date
FROM Treatments T1
JOIN Dogs D ON T1.dog_id = D.dog_id
sql.W2: SELECT T1.date_arrived, T1.date_departed FROM Dogs AS T1 JOIN Treatments AS T2 ON T1.dog_id = T2.dog_id WHERE T2.treatment_type_code IS NOT NULL
sql.W3: SELECT T1.date_arrived, T1.date_departed FROM Dogs AS T1 JOIN Treatments AS T2 ON T1.dog_id = T2.dog_id WHERE T1.date_departed IS NOT NULL AND T2.treatment_type_code IS NOT NULL
sql.W4: SELECT T1.date_arrived, T1.date_departed FROM Dogs AS T1 JOIN Treatments AS T2 ON T1.dog_id = T2.dog_id WHERE T1.date_departed IS NOT NULL AND T1.date_departed > T2.date_of_treatment
sql.E: SELECT T1.date_arrived, T1.date_departed FROM Dogs AS T1 JOIN Treatments AS T2 ON T1.dog_id = T2.dog_id WHERE T1.date_departed IS NOT NULL AND T2.treatment_id IS NOT NULL

question: Which customers have spent more than $40 in total?

sql.W1: SELECT CustomerId FROM Invoice WHERE Total > 40 GROUP BY CustomerId
sql.W2:
SELECT c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName, SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS TotalSpent
FROM Customer c
JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
JOIN InvoiceLine il ON i.InvoiceId = il.InvoiceId
GROUP BY c.CustomerId
HAVING TotalSpent > 40.00
sql.W3:
SELECT c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName, SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS TotalSpent
FROM Customer c
JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
JOIN InvoiceLine il ON i.InvoiceId = il.InvoiceId
GROUP BY c.CustomerId
HAVING TotalSpent > 40.00
sql.W4:
SELECT c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName, SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS TotalSpent
FROM Customer c
JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
JOIN InvoiceLine il ON i.InvoiceId = il.InvoiceId
GROUP BY c.CustomerId
HAVING TotalSpent > 40.00
sql.E: SELECT CustomerId, FirstName, LastName FROM Customer WHERE CustomerId IN (SELECT CustomerId FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId HAVING SUM(Total) > 40)
